answer.reason: The request is for a tile with a large product screenshot inside a section of picture tiles. The Bento Section component (BentoSection) is the section that holds a set of tiles, and it links its items through its BentoCards field, which points to the BentoCard content model. BentoCard has the fields a tile needs: Eyebrow, Title, Description, and a Graphic image. Its guidance says it is for showcasing product screenshots or graphics in a mosaic layout. I rejected GalleryImage because it is only a captioned picture with no title, description, or graphic-led card layout, and FeatureItem because it uses an icon and link. I did not save anything.
